breaking.change: Recipe-generated effect sheets preserve their authored grid, colour ramps, alpha and outlines instead of being conformed a second time as sprites. Pixel looks no longer shrink thin effects or replace ramp steps and highlights with a black sprite outline.
breaking.fix: Re-cook vfx2d effects. Author their resolution, palette, ramps and outline in the recipe; the look still controls frame-level treatment. No per-effect conform override is needed.

fixed.summary: A fully transparent conformed texture no longer emits an empty adaptive palette that fails to cook when outline width is zero.
